chunks: Sa'd, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from 'Ubayd Allah al-Halabi, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the sick person: does he make up the salat (prayer) when he had lost consciousness? He said: No, except for the salat (prayer) during which he regained consciousness.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the obligatory salat (prayer) being asked about
key_terms.الْمَرِيضِ: the sick person under discussion in the ruling
key_terms.يَقْضِي: to make up an act of worship after its time has passed

ai.seo_question: Does an unconscious sick person have to make up missed salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a sick person who becomes unconscious. It states that he does not make up the missed salat (prayer) from the period of unconsciousness, except the salat (prayer) whose time remained when he regained consciousness.
